fusions.name: Stray Surge
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Sends a bolt of raw force into the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 damage. It then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Unfiltered Trample
fusions.desc: Lets raw force out in every direction, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Slow Rumination
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds. Fighting beside others pays: +10% per ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Shielded by Spellwork
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, you gain a shield worth 6% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
